items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Billy Eckstein and myself were making $10.00 a night... Billy Eckstein and myself, we'll make 15... Billy Eckstein wrote the lyrics... we organized and founded the band

ctx.x: We would plan our tour, and that's why we had Charlie up there. Well, in the meantime we were paying Earl $15.00 a night, and Billy Eckstein and myself were making $10.00 a night and we were paying the men seven. Now, we have saved so much money for Earl, so one night Earl came to us and says "okay, fellas, he says, look, $15.00 a night ain't enough for me, I'm the band leader, he says I got to have more money." So we said, okay, Earl -- see, he had to come before us

before he could do anything. And we handle all the business so we knew everything that was going on. So we said, okay then Earl, I mean, you'll get 20, I says, so -- and Billy Eckstein and myself, we'll make 15. We'll raise the guys to 10. Because we're doing pretty good now.
